member.name: M:Certyfi.Api.Controllers.PartnerController.IssueCredential(Certyfi.Api.Controllers.PartnerIssueCredentialRequest,System.Threading.CancellationToken)
member.summary: Issue a credential.
member.remarks: Returns 201 with the new credential. If externalReference matches a credential this key already created, nothing new is created and that credential is returned with 200, so retries are safe. The credential is PendingApproval until an approver at the institution approves it, or Active immediately if the key was created with auto-issue. If the key requires payment it starts as AwaitingPayment until the student pays in the student portal. Certyfi emails the student a link to the student portal (and again when the certificate is issued). Requires credentials:write.

member.summary: List credentials this key created, newest first.
member.remarks: Filter by externalReference to look up the credential for one record in your system. limit defaults to 50 (max 200). Requires credentials:read.

member.name: M:Certyfi.Api.Controllers.PartnerController.RevokeCredential(System.Guid,Certyfi.Api.Controllers.PartnerRevokeCredentialRequest,System.Threading.CancellationToken)
member.summary: Ask for a credential this key created to be revoked.
member.remarks: Revoking is permanent, so it needs a person at the institution to approve it: this records a revocation request and returns 202 Accepted with revocationRequested: true. The credential stays as it is until someone approves it; status then becomes Revoked (poll GET /credentials/{id}). Calling again while a request is waiting returns the same 202. Only Active or Suspended credentials can be revoked. A reason is required. Requires credentials:revoke.

member.name: M:Certyfi.Api.Controllers.PartnerController.CancelCredential(System.Guid,Certyfi.Api.Controllers.PartnerCancelCredentialRequest,System.Threading.CancellationToken)
member.summary: Cancel a credential that hasn't been issued yet.
member.remarks: For a credential this key requested that is still AwaitingPayment or PendingApproval (e.g. the enrolment was cancelled). It becomes Cancelled straight away: the student can no longer pay for it, an approver can no longer approve it, and the student is emailed. Cancelling one that's already cancelled returns it again (200). An issued credential gets 409; revoke it instead. Requires credentials:write.

Pattern:
^(\\d{1,4})[/.\\- ](\\d{1,2})[/.\\- ](\\d{1,4})$
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ 1st capture group.
○ Match a Unicode digit atomically at least 1 and at most 4 times.
○ Match a character in the set [ \--/].
○ 2nd capture group.
○ Match a Unicode digit atomically at least 1 and at most 2 times.
○ Match a character in the set [ \--/].
○ 3rd capture group.
○ Match a Unicode digit atomically at least 1 and at most 4 times.
○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.

member.remarks:
Pattern:
^[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+$
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ Match a character in the set [^@\s] atomically at least once.
○ Match '@'.
○ Match a character in the set [^@\s] greedily at least once.
○ Match '.'.
○ Match a character in the set [^@\s] atomically at least once.
○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.
